build_phi4_multimodal_causal_lm: build a Phi-4 multimodal causal language model that processes images, audio, and text inputs for generation
create_phi4_multimodal_config: create a Phi4MultimodalConfig with vision and audio sub-configs for initializing the multimodal model
build_phi4_multimodal_vision_encoder: build a vision encoder based on Siglip that extracts image features from pixel values using attention pooling
build_phi4_multimodal_audio_encoder: build an audio encoder with conformer layers, Nemo conv subsampling, and streaming chunked attention for audio processing
test_phi4_multimodal_feature_embedding: test the Phi4MultimodalFeatureEmbedding module that merges image and audio embeddings into text token embeddings
